_readme: Install first: uv tool install path/to/claude-buddy-bridge
BUDDY_TIMEOUT=0  — display only, never blocks Claude Code
BUDDY_TIMEOUT=30 — wait up to 30 s for deny on device, then auto-approve (default)
Permission gating — keep ONE of PreToolUse or PermissionRequest, not both.
PreToolUse: gates every tool call (even ones already in your allow list).
PermissionRequest: gates only calls Claude Code would otherwise prompt for.
